about: Cases for eval/scamcheck-task-scam-payment-demand.test.mjs. All messages are made up. "before" is production commit f7f18c5; "after" is with the pay-to-get-paid signal. The expectation of each case is hand-written; scores are recorded. Categories S1 to S3 were added by the selective pass and F1 to F3 by the final pass of 11 Oct 2026. knownFalsePositive = a legitimate message that IS flagged; documentedGap = a demand that is NOT flagged. Owner rulings of 19 Oct 2026: class 1 fixed (FK-02 now unflagged); F-08 fixed (AD-11 now flagged); the Hinglish demand patterns removed from P1 (Hinglish cases keep production results (HG-12, an English demand inside a mixed message, is still flagged by the English rule)); SK-02 and SK-06 relabelled as correct warnings; every other knownFalsePositive accepted by the owner (acceptedByOwner, fpClass).

cases.text: Deposit ₹1,000 to release your commission. Offer ends today!!!
cases.note: trailing punctuation (replaces AD-14 for that check)

cases.text: Pay ₹300 to release your withdrawal.
cases.note: "withdrawal" is a locked object word on its own

cases.text: Pay ₹1,500 so you can withdraw your earnings.
cases.note: "so you can": the locked "so that you can" with "that" left out

cases.text: Your task balance is ₹4,200. Pay ₹500 to withdraw cash at another bank's ATM.
cases.note: D-4: task wording in the message, so the ATM wording is a demand

cases.text: Work from home job payout is ready: pay ₹300 to withdraw cash from other bank ATMs.
cases.note: D-4: job and payout wording

cases.text: Commission credited to your card. To withdraw cash at another bank's ATM, pay ₹250.
cases.note: D-4: goal-first form, commission wording

cases.text: Part-time job offer. Pay ₹300 to withdraw cash at other bank ATMs.
cases.note: D-4: job wording only (none of earnings / commission / salary / payout / tasks)

cases.text: A tax fee of ₹900 must be paid to release your earnings.
cases.note: "tax fee": the fee name comes from the locked release gate ("a tax or clearance fee demanded to release earnings")

cases.text: To withdraw your earnings, pay 12% TDS first.
cases.note: D-1: a percentage directly after the payment verb

cases.text: To withdraw, pay a 20% security tax now.
cases.note: D-1: an article between the verb and the percentage

cases.text: To withdraw your earnings, please pay the 18% GST.
Your commission will be unlocked as soon as you deposit ₹2,000.
Your earnings will be released after you pay the processing fee of ₹500.
cases.note: D-2: the amount within 25 characters of the verb

cases.text: Your payout will be released after you pay 5% tax.
cases.note: D-2 with a percentage directly after the verb

cases.text: A processing fee is required for every withdrawal above ₹10,000.
cases.note: D-6: the locked form is "a … fee is required … TO release your earnings"; without a purpose word this is a fee notice. Flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions

cases.text: A withdrawal fee is required for withdrawals to a bank account.
cases.note: same

cases.text: A genuine company won't ask you to pay to withdraw your salary.
cases.note: negated: "won't" is a contraction of the locked "not"; "ask you to" an inflection of the locked "asks you to"

cases.text: You shouldn't pay to withdraw your own earnings.
cases.note: negated: contraction of the locked "not"

cases.text: You never have to pay to withdraw your earnings.
cases.note: negated: the verb is preceded by the locked "never"

cases.text: Don't ever pay to withdraw your earnings.
cases.note: negated: the verb is preceded by the locked "don't"

cases.text: Dear customer, you need to pay ₹23 to withdraw cash at other bank ATMs beyond the free limit.
cases.note: D-4: the bank notice

cases.text: Pay ₹999 to withdraw cash at other bank ATMs.
cases.note: D-4: the exception itself. The bare wording, with no earnings, task or job wording anywhere, is not flagged whoever sends it

cases.text: To withdraw early, pay attention to the 30% tax rule.
cases.note: D-1: the percentage is not what is paid. Flagged by the selective candidate

cases.text: To withdraw, pay nothing extra: only 2% is deducted automatically.
cases.note: D-1: same. Flagged by the selective candidate

cases.text: Pay ₹100 to get your salary certificate from the HR portal.
cases.note: KNOWN FALSE POSITIVE, pinned (decision D-6): "get your salary" is the locked object; the exception for salary slip / certificate / statement was wider wording and is gone. Not flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions

cases.text: You can cash out anytime without having to pay to withdraw.
cases.note: FIXED by the owner's class-1 ruling of 19 Oct 2026: "without having to" is now in the negation guard. Was a known false positive (decision D-6).

cases.text: Salary account holders pay ₹21 to withdraw cash at other bank ATMs after five free transactions.
cases.note: KNOWN FALSE POSITIVE, pinned (decision D-4): a bank notice that contains the word "salary", so the ATM wording is judged like any other sentence. Flagged on 9 Oct too

cases.text: Your salary will be credited when you deposit the signed bond on ₹100 stamp paper.
cases.note: KNOWN FALSE POSITIVE, pinned: a third legitimate look-alike of decision D-2, found by a probe written in the final pass

cases.text: Send only ₹500 to withdraw your earnings.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked: send / add / transfer count "only when an amount follows directly"

cases.text: Deposit ₹2,000 and you will receive your commission today.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. "and you will" is not a locked purpose link

cases.text: Last step: pay ₹999 and you can withdraw immediately.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. "and you can" is not a locked purpose link

cases.text: Pay ₹500, after which you can withdraw your earnings.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. "after which you can" is not a locked purpose link

cases.text: Pay ₹1,000 to release all earnings.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked determiners: your / my / the

cases.text: Pay ₹700 to claim your total commission.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked object: "your commission" with nothing in between

cases.text: Deposit ₹2,000 into our task account today.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked: "your / the" task account

cases.text: Fund your task account with ₹1,500 to open the order.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. "fund" is not a locked payment verb

cases.text: An activation fee of ₹500 is required to release your earnings.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked fee names: verification, clearance, withdrawal, processing (and "tax" from the release gate)

cases.text: A clearance charge of ₹800 must be paid to withdraw your commission.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked noun: fee

cases.text: A verification fee of ₹1,200 is payable to release your earnings.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked: "is required / must be paid"

cases.text: Before you can withdraw, pay ₹500 verification fee.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. The locked goal-first form starts "to withdraw"

cases.text: To cash out, pay ₹200 handling fee.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Same

cases.text: To withdraw you must complete the merchant order first.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked: "the prepaid task" (and "prepaid order", from spec case A-17)

cases.text: Your commission is ready. Pay ₹300 to complete your order.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked weak goal: "complete the task / order"

cases.text: Work from home task: send ₹500 and receive ₹800 back in 5 minutes.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked: "send ₹X and get ₹Y back"

cases.text: Telegram task group: send ₹1,000 and get ₹1,300 profit today.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Same

cases.text: Telegram task group: send ₹500, then get ₹800 back.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Same

cases.text: This is a prepaid order. Recharge ₹2,000 to continue.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked context: "prepaid or merchant task"

cases.text: Payout ke liye pehle ₹500 recharge karo.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked Hinglish goal words: withdrawal, nikalne

cases.text: Withdrawal se pehle ₹1,000 recharge karo.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked Hinglish link: "ke liye"

cases.text: Withdrawal ke liye ₹500 payment karo.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked verbs with "karo": pay, deposit, recharge, top up

cases.text: Withdrawal ke liye paise bhejo.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. Locked: an amount or "fee" before "bhejo"

cases.text: Paise nikalne ke liye pehle 1000 rupaye jama karo.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-6): wording outside the locked lists; flagged by the 9 Oct and selective versions. "1000 rupaye" is not read as an amount (locked examples use ₹ and Rs). One of the 71 readiness probes (S-11)

cases.text: To withdraw, pay tax of 30% first.
cases.note: DOCUMENTED GAP (decision D-1, accepted narrowly): the percentage must come directly after the payment verb. Flagged by the selective candidate
